title: High-throughput, Automated Extraction of DNA and RNA from Clinical Samples using TruTip Technology on Common Liquid Handling Robots
protocol: Bring nasopharyngeal samples to room temperature before starting the extraction.
Dispense 100 μl of nasopharyngeal aspirate plus 150 μl nuclease-free water into column 1 of the sample plate.
Place the sample plate into position B1 on the epMotion Worktable.
Place pipette tips, TruTips, and 30 ml reagent troughs onto their respective positions on the epMotion Worktable.
Open the Eppendorf epBlue software and select the Run file provided by Akonni for 8 samples.
Load the method by clicking the RUN button on the RUN tab.
Under Level Sensor Settings, select Levels and Tips, and click the RUN button again.
Input the sample volume into the software and click RUN.
Add 3.5 ml of 95% ethanol to position B2 reagent trough for extraction.
Add 9.0 ml of Wash Buffer D to position B3 reagent trough for washing.
Add 9.0 ml of Wash Buffer E to position B4 reagent trough for washing.
Add 1.3 ml of Elution Buffer A2 to position B5 reagent trough for elution.
Add 11.0 ml of Lysis and Binding Buffer D to position B6 reagent trough for lysis and binding.
Input reagent volumes into the Table presented by the epMotion software.
Select RUN to start the automated method.
Dispense 375 μl Lysis Buffer D into column 1.
Mix for 10 cycles (one cycle equals apirate + dispense).
Dispense 1.6 ml Wash Buffer D into column 2.
Dispense 1.6 ml Wash Buffer E into column 3.
Dispense 50 μl Elution Buffer A into column 4.
Pause for 6 min to complete the 10 min sample incubation in Lysis Buffer D.
Add 375 μl ethanol to each well in column 1.
Mix each sample with ethanol through 10 pipetting cycles.
Load 8 TruTips from position A2 on the Worktable.
Begin the extraction process.
Aspirate and dispense sample/lysis buffer/ethanol mixture from column 1 of the sample plate for seven cycles to bind nucleic acid to the TruTip monolith.
Move TruTips to sample plate column 2, and cycle Wash Buffer D 5x over the monolith to remove residual lysis buffer and sample matrix.
Move TruTips to sample plate column 3, and cycle Wash Buffer E 5x over the monolith to remove proteins and other contaminants from the bound nucleic acid.
Move TruTips to the empty reagent reservoir position 1 (in Worktable location B2) and cycle 80x at a fast flow rate to dry the monolith.
Move TruTips to sample plate column 4, and cycle Elution Buffer A 5x over the monolith.
Eject TruTips into the epMotion waste bin.
Turn on the STAR instrument and computer.
Open the Hamilton Run Control software.
Open the Run file provided by Akonni for 96 samples.
Place labware onto the STAR deck as shown in Figure 3.
Dispense reagents into their corresponding troughs.
Allow samples to equilibrate to room temperature.
Place the sample tubes in the Sample Carrier racks, starting from the rear of the far left carrier and moving sequentially down each carrier.
Transfer 200 μl from each sample tube to the incubation plate at position 14 on the heater/shaker module.
Dispense 80 μl proteinase K into each sample well of the incubation plate.
Dispense 600 μl Lysis Buffer F into each well of the incubation plate.
Mix the solution for 10 cycles.
Incubate the solution for 20 min at 70 °C and 500 rpm.
Dispense 100 μl Elution Buffer A into each well of the deep well plate at position 13.
Dispense 800 μl ethanol into each well of the deep well plate at position 10.
Dispense 1.6 ml Wash Buffer K into each well of the deep well plate at position 12.
Mix 1.6 ml of Wash Buffer J into each well of the deep well plate at position 11.
Incubate the sample mixture for 20 minutes.
Transfer the sample mixture from the incubation plate to the deep well plate at position 10.
Perform 12 pipetting cycles to mix the transferred samples.
Eject reagent tips into the waste bin.
Load 96 TruTips from deck position 3.
Aspirate and dispense the sample/lysis buffer/ethanol mixture in position 10 for 10 cycles.
Move TruTips to position 11.
Cycle Wash Buffer J over the monolith 5 times.
Move TruTips to position 12.
Cycle Wash Buffer K over the monolith 5 times.
Cycle the TruTip at high speed 40 times to air dry.
Move TruTips to position 13.
Cycle Elution Buffer A2 in the TruTips 5 times.
Transfer the extracted and purified nucleic acid from the deep well plate into appropriate tubes for storage or downstream applications.
Turn on the STARplus instrument and computer.
Open the Hamilton Run Control software.
Open the Run file provided by Akonni for 8 large volume plasma samples.
Place labware onto the STARplus deck as shown in Figure 4.
Dispense CN-W1 into reservoir position 5A.
Dispense CN-W2 into reservoir position 5B.
Dispense CN-W4 into reservoir position 5C.
Dispense Proteinase K (20 mg ml-1) into reservoir position 6A.
Dispense EBB into reservoir position 6B.
Dispense EBA2 into reservoir position 6C.
Dispense CN-W3 into reservoir position 6D.
Dispense CN-B2 into reservoir position 6E.
Dispense CN-B3 into reservoir position 6F.
Dispense CN-L1 into reservoir position 7.
Dispense CN-B1 into reservoir position 8.
Allow the sample to equilibrate to room temperature.
Place the sample tubes in the Sample Carrier racks, with Sample 1 in the rear and moving sequentially toward the front of the deck.
Incubate the sample with proteinase K and lysis buffer to homogenize the sample and release DNA.
Add 615 μl of proteinase K, 5 ml plasma, and 6.2 ml Lysis Buffer CN-L1 to each 50 ml conical tube.
Remove the 50 ml conical tubes from the sample deck.
Vortex for 30 sec on high speed.
Incubate off-line for 30 min at 60 °C in a water bath or heat block.
Resume the automated script after incubation to continue dispensing reagents into their respective plates and wells.
Add 2 ml CN-W1 to every other well in position 9 column 1.
Add 2 ml CN-W2 to every other well in position 9 column 2.
Add 2 ml CN-W4 to every other well in position 9 column 3.
Add 250 μl EBA2 to every other well in position 9 columns 4 and 5.
Add 495 μl CN-B2 to every other well in position 10 column 1.
Add 1 ml EBB to every other well in position 10 column 2.
Dispense 500 μl of CN-W3 into every other well in position 10 column 3.
Dispense 500 μl of CN-W4 into every other well in position 10 column 4.
Dispense 50 μl of EBA2 into every other well in position 10 column 5.
Incubate the samples at 60°C for 30 minutes.
Place the 50 ml conical tubes on ice for 5 minutes after incubation.
Return the 50 ml conical tubes to their original positions within the sample carrier rack at deck position 4.
Add 12 ml of Binding Buffer CN-B1 to each sample tube and mix 10 times.
Pick up 5 ml TruTips from position 2 for large-volume nucleic acid extraction.
Cycle the sample mixture 15 times in the 50 ml conical tube, starting at the bottom and moving 3 mm higher after each cycle.
Move TruTips to the deep well plates at position 6 column 1 and cycle once in Wash Buffer CN-W1.
Move TruTips to position 9 column 2 and cycle once in Wash CN-W2.
Move TruTips to position 9 column 3 and cycle twice in Wash CN-W4.
Move TruTips to position 9 column 4 and cycle 40x at high speed to dry binding matrix.
Move TruTips to position 9 column 5 and cycle 10x to elute the bound nucleic acids from the 5 ml TruTips.
Move TruTips to column 6 and repeat the step with the second aliquot of elution buffer.
Transfer elution #2 into position 9 column 5 to combine it with elution #1, and discard the TruTips.
Add combined eluant from step 22 to position 10 column 1 and mix thoroughly 10x.
Pick up 1 ml TruTips from position 13 and cycle 20x to bind the high molecular weight DNA to the monolith.
Move the TruTips to position 10 column 2 and cycle 5x to rinse the tip and remove high molecular weight DNA.
Add 575 μl of Binding Buffer CN-B3 to the sample in position 10 column 1 and mix 10x.
Pick up the TruTips from step 25, return to position 10 column 1, and cycle 20x to bind the remaining DNA from the sample to the 1 ml TruTip.
Move TruTips to position 10 column 4 and cycle 1x in Wash CN-W3 to remove any remaining inhibitors.
Move the TruTips to position 10 column 5 and cycle 1x in Wash CN-W4 to rinse residual salts from CN-W3.
Raise TruTips over position 10 column 5.
Cycle air through the tips 35 times to dry the monolith.
Move TruTips to position 10 column 6.
Cycle 10 times in EBA2 to elute the purified, size-selected and concentrated nucleic acid.
Discard TruTips.
Transfer the eluted sample from column 6 to 1.5 ml tubes in position 11.
Extracted samples are ready for storage or downstream processing.
